option_relations.rationale: Pheochromocytoma-induced cardiomyopathy is a specific type of cardiomyopathy caused by pheochromocytoma, which is related to the leaf disease pheochromocytoma
Primary Takotsubo (stress) cardiomyopathy is also known as apical ballooning syndrome, which is equivalent to the leaf diseases Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy and Apical Ballooning Syndrome
Pheochromocytoma crisis can be an etiology of Takotsubo cardiomyopathy or apical ballooning syndrome, but it is not a direct match
Acute pericarditis is not directly related to the leaf diseases or the clinical presentation
